entities.name: Cloud Provider Event Sources
entities.rationale: Unlabeled incoming arrow on the left entering the Collect Kinesis stream; transcript describes cloud providers' native security event streams (CloudWatch events, Azure activity log) feeding the collection framework.

entities.name: Collect Kinesis Data Streams
entities.rationale: Top-left purple icon labeled 'KINESIS DATA STREAMS' under the heading 'COLLECT' (AWS_Icon_10). Receives collected cloud resources.

entities.name: Neptune
entities.rationale: Center icon labeled 'NEPTUNE' (AWS_Icon_7). Primary graph persistence; annotated with '50M+' resources nearby.

entities.name: Elasticsearch
entities.rationale: Top-center icon labeled 'ELASTICSEARCH' (AWS_Icon_11). Backing store for search/aggregations; mapped to OpenSearch.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Bottom-center icon labeled 'DYNAMODB' (AWS_Icon_4). Backing store for resource change history and security violations.

entities.name: CloudWatch
entities.rationale: Right-side pink icon labeled 'CLOUDWATCH' (AWS_Icon_8). Provides metrics from Neptune and Elasticsearch to the sharder service.

entities.name: Sharder Service
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn box labeled 'SHARD' at top right (AWS_Icon_9). Custom sharder service that uses CloudWatch metrics to decide shard capacity; a curved arrow flows back from it toward the collection/Neptune write path.

entities.name: Rules Kinesis Data Streams
entities.rationale: Bottom-left purple icon labeled 'KINESIS DATA STREAMS' under the heading 'RULES' (AWS_Icon_6). Fronts the rule execution pipeline.

entities.name: Email Notifications
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn envelope icon at the bottom right (AWS_Icon_5 region), representing email notifications to customers.

entities.name: Slack
entities.rationale: Slack logo drawn at the bottom right (AWS_Icon_1/2/3 region); real-time notification channel (Slack, Splunk and similar) for security violations.

visual_connections.description: Arrow from the left entering the Collect Kinesis stream: collected cloud events/resources are published into the stream.
Curved arrow from the Collect stream down to Neptune: consumer publishes resources (50M+) into the graph database.
Curved arrow from Neptune up to Elasticsearch: resource data also stored for search and aggregations.
Curved arrow from Neptune down to DynamoDB: resource data stored as a backing store for change history.
Straight arrow from Neptune to CloudWatch: Neptune metrics (CPU, memory) emitted to CloudWatch.
Arrow from Elasticsearch down-right to CloudWatch: Elasticsearch metrics emitted to CloudWatch.
No distinct line drawn between them, but the SHARD box sits directly above CloudWatch and the transcript says the sharder uses CloudWatch metrics; inferred rather than explicitly drawn.

Long curved arrow from above the SHARD box arching over the top of the board and pointing down near '50M+' between the Collect stream and Neptune: shard capacity information flows back to the write path.
Short downward arrow from below the Collect stream to the RULES heading: incoming events propagate to the rule execution pipeline.
Short curved arrow from the left side of Neptune down to the RULES heading: resource changes propagate to the rule execution pipeline.
Curved arrow from the Rules stream up to Neptune: rules are executed against the graph database.
Arrow from the Rules stream right to DynamoDB: detected security violations are persisted.
Long curved arrow from the Rules stream sweeping under DynamoDB and ending at the bottom right between the envelope and the Slack logo: real-time notifications to customers.
Same long curved arrow ending between the envelope and the Slack logo: real-time email notifications to customers.
